content.text: I fixed the bug in `solution/core.py`, and the visible suite now passes (2 passed). In `parse_csv_line`, the check for an escaped quote inside a quoted field looked for a single quote (`'`) after a double quote, when it should have looked for another double quote (`"`). So `""` was never treated as an escaped quote. The first `"` closed the field early, and the next one raised "character after closing quote". I changed the comparison to `'"'`, and nothing else changed.
